sources.title: 2023年李强简历：出生年月、工作起点及学历
sources.findings: Read the official March 2023 short biography. Use birth month only, native place rather than an independently verified birthplace, and distinguish postgraduate educational qualification from EMBA degree. This historical biography alone is not proof of a November 2026 current office.

sources.title: 李强完整履历：地方任职、课程进修与EMBA
sources.findings: Read the detailed career chronology. Agricultural mechanization study, management engineering coursework, Central Party School postgraduate qualification and Hong Kong Polytechnic University EMBA are different forms of study. Do not turn all of them into degree awards or duplicate master’s degrees. The October 25 URL contains a later Shanghai appointment in its updated text; use the separate October 29 announcement for that event.

sources.title: 2012年12月21日任浙江副省长、代理省长
sources.findings: Read the contemporary report of the provincial standing committee decision on 21 December 2012. Acting governor and vice-governor are not the subsequent elected governorship. Do not backdate the formal governor stage to all of 2012.

sources.title: 2013年1月30日当选浙江省省长
sources.findings: Read the January 30 contemporaneous report, including the session and election result. This supports the precise election date rather than relying on next-day republication dates. The adjoining Xia Baolong biography and doctorate belong to another person.

sources.title: 2016年6月30日江苏会议宣布省委书记调整
sources.findings: Read the June 30 Jiangsu announcement. It reports a central decision made recently and publicly announced at that day’s officials’ meeting. The timeline records the announcement meeting, without inventing the earlier date of the central decision or confusing later provincial Party elections with initial accession.

sources.title: 2017年10月29日上海会议宣布市委书记调整
sources.findings: Read the October 29 Shanghai announcement. Separate city Party secretary from mayor and central Politburo membership from Standing Committee membership acquired later. The reported recent central decision and the date of its public announcement are not automatically identical.

sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国外交部
sources.title: 转载2022年10月23日中共二十届一中全会公报
sources.findings: Read the first-plenum communiqué and membership lists. The meeting occurred October 23; the ministry republication is October 24. The Party election does not appoint the State Council premier. Other officials named on the 2022 list are not assumed to retain their positions in 2026.

sources.title: 2023年3月11日中华人民共和国主席令第一号
sources.findings: Read Presidential Order No. 1 dated 11 March 2023, following the NPC decision. The March 12 posting timestamp is not the appointment date. This is a state appointment, not a direct popular election; Li Qiang is not predecessor Li Keqiang or President Xi Jinping.

sources.title: 2023 profile of Li Qiang: career, appointment, business and lockdown
sources.findings: Read the Reuters career and appointment profile. Public text attributes the Tesla link rather than asserting sole personal responsibility. The description of his prospective influence is analysis, not proof that he subsequently strengthened the premiership. Education shorthand about master’s degrees is replaced with the official distinctions. Reports about lockdown and business ties are not criminal adjudications.

sources.title: 6 April 2022: access to non-Covid treatment and essential supplies in Shanghai
sources.findings: Read HRW’s April 2022 statement as reproduced by ecoi.net. It is an attributed human-rights organization’s account, not a court judgment against Li personally. Public text summarizes access to essentials; individual deaths, unverified social-media anecdotes and assumed personal orders are not added.

sources.title: 3 May 2022: Tesla letter and Shanghai authorities’ assistance with reopening
sources.findings: Read Reuters’ reporting on the Tesla letter and factory reopening. Company gratitude and local support do not establish Li personally arranged every operational measure, nor do they negate the wider impact of restrictions. Expansion plans in the letter are not treated as completed capacity.

sources.title: 2026年政府工作报告提出经济增长4.5%至5%等预期目标
sources.findings: Read the short Xinhua report on the March 2026 government-work-report targets. Growth is a range and a target, not a November observation or full-year outcome. Only the selected target extract was read, not the entire government report or an independent statistical audit.

sources.publisher: 新华社／中国共产党新闻网
sources.title: 2026年11月16日马尼拉第29次中国—东盟领导人会议讲话
sources.findings: Read the substantive speech sections identifying Li as premier and recording his November 16 Manila remarks. Cooperation proposals and future training or scholarship commitments are not completed results. His statements about trade and investment are not independently audited statistics; public text omits those totals.

sources.title: 16 November 2026: Li Qiang addresses ASEAN meeting in Manila
sources.findings: Read Reuters’ current report confirming the November 16 meeting and his participation as premier. Future events mentioned elsewhere in the article are not evidence of completed attendance. This independently supports the current-role and recent-activity check; it does not verify every policy claim in the speech.

portraitReview.license: Attribution on Commons; Council Newsroom-specific terms not yet verified
portraitReview.credit: European Union; crop uploaded by Sashi Suseshi
portraitReview.unresolved: Read Commons crop and parent description, metadata and history. Caption identifies the Kuala Lumpur meeting with European Council President Costa on 27 October 2025; timestamp is 03:40:22, not an independently validated camera clock. Crop 934×1207, 178 KB uploaded 26 November 2025 at 11:51; parent 4503×3000, 5.16 MB uploaded 25 November at 11:57, both by Sashi Suseshi. Commons labels Attribution and uses a European Commission template referring to Decision 2011/833, while the original is from the European Council/Council Newsroom. These institutions and legal policies cannot be silently equated. Read the Council’s general copyright rules: acknowledge source, preserve meaning, identify modifications, respect any specific and third-party restrictions. It directs readers to special Newsroom conditions; the item and About page expose no readable body, so image-specific permission remains unconfirmed. No stored portrait-cache fields in the raw evidence and no cache directory in this checkout. One original-image request on 18 November returned curl exit 22 with 403/HTTP 000, with no local file. No pixels inspected; identity, colour, framing, orientation and sharpness remain unreviewed.

remainingWork: Verify Council Newsroom-specific photo permission and any third-party credit or conditions; do not substitute the Commission template automatically. Obtain original and crop and visually check identity, colour, orientation, sharpness and framing.
Refresh current office and material policy developments before publication; preserve source attribution, date precision and target-versus-outcome distinctions.
